pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī aññatarissā itthiyā kulupikā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.3: athakho sā itthī taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.4: handayye imaṃ saṅghāṇiṃ amukāya nāma itthiyā dehīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.6: sacāhaṃ pattena ādāya gacchāmi vissaro me bhavissatīti paṭimuñcitvā agamāsi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.9: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo saṅghāṇiṃ dhāressanti seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.10: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.11: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī saṅghāṇiṃ dhāressatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.13: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī saṅghāṇiṃ dhāretīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.16: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī saṅghāṇiṃ dhāressati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.18: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc86:1.19.1: yā pana bhikkhunī saṅghāṇiṃ dhāreyya pācittiyanti.
